app_description.message: Improvements to the JetPhotos upload experience.

app_subtitle.message: Less "Bad info" more "Too much or too little contrast"

offline_subtitle.message: Preview how JetPhotos will equalize your photo before uploading.

offline_dropzone.message: Drop an image here, or click to select

offline_compress_tooltip.message: JetPhoto's upload tools renders a compressed version of your uploaded image. Use this option to see the most faithful representation of what the online tools are like.

option_fetch_reg_desc.message: Checks whether the user has accepted photos with the provided registration.

option_latest_date_desc.message: Returns the most recent photo taken date for the provided registration.

option_manual_date_desc.message: Allows inputting the photo date as a string (MM/DD/YYYY) instead of being forced to use the date picker.

option_iata_icao_desc.message: Automatically suggests the ICAO equivalent when an IATA airport code is entered.

option_hide_guidelines_desc.message: Hides the submission guidelines text found on the left-hand side of the upload page.

option_localize_utc_desc.message: Converts UTC timestamps on the page to your local time zone.

about_bmc_prompt.message: Find this extension helpful? Send me a coffee! ☕

about_feature_iata.message: Support for automatically swapping a provided IATA airport code for its ICAO equivalent

about_feature_offline.message: Offline tools: centering lines, horizon grid overlay, equalization, histogram preview

about_bugfix_trim.message: Input fields automatically trimmed of leading/trailing spaces

about_bugfix_serial.message: Serial number preserved when registration has no auto-fill match

about_bugfix_reg_copy.message: Registration auto-populated in form when not found in auto-fill database

content_existing_entry.message: Click here to view your existing submission(s)
